extraction_project.title: Knowledge Graph Extraction for THE_GAMBIA (1867-1965)
extraction_project.methodology: Manual LLM-based entity extraction with full provenance tracking

files_found.note: Some years have both THE_GAMBIA.md and GAMBIA.md files

years_processed.significance: First year of available data. Colony administered from Sierra Leone in 1866.
Protectorate system being established. Anglo-French boundary delimitation.
Protectorate fully divided into five provinces. Sankandi incident documented.
Major constitutional reforms. Executive and Legislative Councils reformed.
Final year before independence (Feb 18, 1965). Full internal self-government since 1963.

data_quality_indicators.schema_validation: All files conform to schema v2.0

colonial_administration.1867: Administered from Sierra Leone with Administrator and Legislative Council
colonial_administration.1900-1920: Protectorate system established with Travelling Commissioners
colonial_administration.1950: Executive and Legislative Councils reformed, African unofficial members added
colonial_administration.1965: Full internal self-government with Cabinet and House of Representatives

territorial_evolution.colony_area: Consistently ~69 square miles (St. Mary's Island, British Kombo, etc.)
territorial_evolution.protectorate_area: ~4,000 square miles extending 200-250 miles along river

administrative_divisions.1920: Five provinces (North Bank, MacCarthy, Upper River, South Bank, Kombo & Foni)
administrative_divisions.1950-1965: Four divisions (Western, Central/Lower River, MacCarthy Island, Upper River)

bathurst.1867: Part of ~5,700 total on St. Mary's Island

population_trends.ethnic_composition: Mandingo, Wollof/Woloff, Fula, Jola, Serahuli consistently documented

economic_patterns.dominant_export: Ground nuts throughout entire period (47 tons in 1837 → 33,000 tons in 1898)

infrastructure_development.1900: 4 telegraph cables, Oyster Creek Bridge, road to Cape St. Mary
infrastructure_development.1950: Yundum Airfield, wireless stations, improved roads, still no railways
infrastructure_development.1965: River navigation to Kuntaur (150 miles), air services, road network

constitutional_milestones.1588: Patent granted by Queen Elizabeth for trade
constitutional_milestones.1816: New settlement formed at St. Mary's Island (Bathurst)

places.location_context_quality: All places have definite location certainty with West Africa context

people.extraction_focus: Governors, Administrators, senior officials with honors and salaries
people.honor_patterns: CMG, KCMG most common; OBE, MBE appear post-WWI; academic titles excluded
people.salary_data: Consistently extracted for civil establishment positions

institutions.composition_tracking: Official vs unofficial members, ex officio positions well documented

economic_data.types_extracted: Revenue, expenditure, imports, exports, production, shipping, debt
economic_data.validation: All marked as plausible with complete data

honors.excluded: Academic degrees (M.A., B.A., etc.) correctly excluded per schema
honors.coverage: Full names and ranks provided from master vocabulary

positions.normalization: Variant titles normalized to canonical forms

entity_ids.format: Follows pattern (place_, person_, inst_, econ_, infra_, demo_, event_)

location_context.actual_location_country: Always Gambia for entities in colony

systematic_approach: Process years in chronological order to track evolution
Focus on administrative changes, population data, economic trends
Track officials with honors for prosopographical research

priority_years.reason: Period when Gambia became separate government again (1888)
Establishment of Protectorate system (1894), Foni and Jarra under British protection (1897)
Inter-war period with consistent administrative structure
Post-WWII constitutional reforms, transition to self-government

entity_extraction_tips: Always extract Governor/Administrator with honors and salary
Legislative Council composition changes over time - track evolution
Economic data tables often span multiple years - extract all
Population data varies in detail - extract all available demographics
Ground nuts production/export consistently mentioned - track growth
Administrative divisions change names - maintain consistency
Protectorate expansion documented in historical sections
Infrastructure projects (bridges, telegraphs, airfields) appear sporadically
quality_assurance: Verify all monetary amounts and dates
Check historical events mentioned for context
Ensure honors abbreviations match controlled vocabulary
Validate population figures against neighboring years
Cross-reference official names across years for continuity
Maintain consistent place naming (e.g., Kombo vs Combo variants)

technical_notes.no_python_used: Per user requirement, all extraction done through LLM capabilities
technical_notes.line_number_references: Based on cat -n output from Read tool

immediate: Create JSON file for each year following established pattern
Maintain consistent entity naming across years
medium_term: Cross-year entity linking (same person across multiple years)
long_term: Integration with other West African colonies for comparative analysis
Graph database import for relationship querying
Academic paper on Gambia's path to independence
